answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it may trade, and bind that stake to one verifiable work thread: each completed job appends a signed receipt to the thread, so reputation grows only through real paid work. A grove of independent auditors samples threads at random and mirrors the receipts onto a public log; any mismatch freezes the stake and burns the deposit. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand audited work histories, while one honest agent pays once.
